indirect_dependencies: history encoder consumes contact history; its input must be rebuilt/retrained
IMU and joint states encode physical contact effects but are available without foot sensors
privileged motor strength/mass/friction are training-only physical parameters, not foot sensors
gait observation optional clock/phase depends on commands/time; current AS2 disabled
reward and termination contact forces are simulation ground truth; independent of actor input
feet_air_time/contact_filt caches are reward state, not additional observation slots
EE trajectory collision uses simulation terrain height; requires separate deploy command validation but is not foot sensor observation
